title: Wells Fargo virtual card: How to create one
summary: Create a Wells Fargo virtual card in minutes and find your card number safely. See how a Grey virtual card compares for spending abroad. Get started.
body_markdown:
Personally, virtual cards win over physical cards for me because I keep losing the card, and sometimes it’s a chore bringing the card out each time I want to shop online or pay for a subscription. Virtual cards offer another way to pay without repeatedly entering your physical card information. If you already bank with[Wells Fargo](https://grey.co/blog/wells-fargo-routing-number) , here's how you can create one and how to get started.


To create a Wells Fargo virtual card, sign in to the Wells Fargo Mobile app or online banking and check the digital payment options available for your eligible card. If virtual card details are supported, follow the prompts to generate or access them. You may also be able to add your eligible card to a digital wallet for contactless payments.


However, availability depends on your card type and the features supported by Wells Fargo. Not every customer can generate a separate virtual card number on demand, so check your account's available options before proceeding.


## **What is a Wells Fargo virtual card?**


A Wells Fargo virtual card is a temporary, digitally generated 16-digit number linked to an existing account. It allows users to make online payments without directly exposing their actual card details, adding another layer of protection against fraud and unauthorised charges.


For businesses, Wells Fargo provides virtual card solutions through its WellsOne commercial card programme. Companies can generate single-use card numbers with custom spending limits, expiration dates, and merchant category restrictions. This makes paying approved suppliers more secure while giving businesses better control over their spending.


For everyday consumers, however, Wells Fargo does not offer standalone virtual card numbers for individual accounts. Instead, personal debit and credit cardholders can use digital payment services such as Apple Pay,[Google Pay](https://grey.co/blog/google-pay-virtual-card) , Samsung Pay,[PayPal](http://grey.co/blog/paypal-virtual-card-guide) , and Paze. These services use encrypted digital tokens to help protect actual card information during transactions.


Of course, Wells Fargo isn't the only option for managing online payments. Services offering[online debit cards](https://grey.co/blog/online-debit-cards) provide another way to pay online without relying on your everyday banking card. Similarly,[prepaid Visa cards](https://grey.co/blog/prepaid-visa-cards) can help users set aside money for specific purchases and keep their spending under control.


## **How to set up a virtual card with Wells Fargo**


If you're a Wells Fargo personal account holder, you can connect an eligible debit or credit card to a digital wallet through the Wells Fargo Mobile app.


Getting started is fairly simple. Here's how to do it.


1. **Sign in:** Download the Wells Fargo Mobile app and log in using your online banking details.
2. **Open the menu:** Tap Menu at the bottom of your screen.
3. **Find card settings:** Select Card Settings from the available options.
4. **Choose Digital Wallet:** Tap this option to see the supported payment services.
5. **Select a wallet:** Choose Apple Pay, Google Pay, or Samsung Pay, depending on your device.
6. **Add your card:** Select your eligible Wells Fargo debit or credit card and tap Add.
7. **Verify your identity:** Follow the instructions on your screen. You may receive a verification code through text, email, or a phone call.


Once verification is complete, your card should be ready to use with the selected digital wallet.


The best part? You can make contactless and online payments without repeatedly entering your physical card details. The digital wallet uses a secure token to help protect your actual card information.


## **How to find your Wells Fargo virtual card number**


Wells Fargo doesn't display a complete, standalone virtual card number in its mobile banking app. Instead, when you add an eligible card to a digital wallet, the wallet generates a hidden digital token linked to your actual card.


**Step 1: Sign in**
Open the Wells Fargo Mobile app and sign in using your username and password (or biometric sign-in).


**Step 2: Tap menu**
Once signed in to your account dashboard, tap Menu in the bottom navigation bar.


**Step 3: Select card settings ‍** From the main menu list, scroll down and select Card Settings.


**Step 4: Choose digital wallet ‍** In the Card Settings menu, choose digital wallet.


**Step 5: Add your card ‍** Select Apple Pay or Google Pay, then tap Add beside your eligible Wells Fargo card and follow the on-screen prompts to complete the setup.


**Step 6: Open your mobile wallet ‍** Once your card is linked, open Apple Wallet or Google Wallet on your phone and select your newly added Wells Fargo card.


**Step 7: View virtual account number ‍** Tap card details (or the info icon) to view the last four digits of your virtual account number.


Remember, these four digits identify the digital wallet's virtual account number, not your complete physical card number. The full tokenised card details are generally not displayed for security reasons.


If you're living outside the United States and wondering whether you can access Wells Fargo banking services, this[guide to opening a Wells Fargo account outside the US](https://grey.co/blog/open-wells-fargo-account-outside-us) provides additional information.


## **How to use your Wells Fargo virtual card safely online**


To get the most out of your Wells Fargo virtual card, it's important to know how to use it safely. A few simple precautions can help protect your money and personal information when shopping online.


- **Limits:** Personal digital wallet tokens share the spending limits or available credit of the original card. However, WellsOne business users can set custom spending limits for individual transactions, making it easier to manage supplier payments.
- **Freezing:** Lost your phone or suspect someone has accessed your card? Open the Wells Fargo Mobile app, go to Card Settings, and turn off your card. This helps prevent new transactions without necessarily closing your account.
- **Good habits:** Enable real-time purchase alerts to monitor transactions as they happen. Always use secure HTTPS websites when making payments, and avoid saving card details on public or shared devices.


These precautions are particularly useful if you regularly make international online purchases. If you're a non-resident looking into US banking options, understanding[whether non-residents can open a US bank account online in 2026](https://grey.co/blog/can-non-residents-open-a-us-bank-account-online-in-2026) can also help you make informed decisions about managing your money.

## Frequently asked questions about Wells Fargo virtual cards


### **1. Does Wells Fargo offer virtual cards?**


Yes, Wells Fargo supports digital card numbers through digital wallets such as Apple Pay, Google Pay and Samsung Pay. However, personal customers cannot generate standalone virtual card numbers like those offered by some other providers. Businesses may also have access to commercial virtual card payment solutions.


### **2. How do I create a Wells Fargo virtual card?**


Open the Wells Fargo Mobile app and sign in. Go to Menu, select Card Settings, then Digital Wallet. Choose an available wallet, such as Apple Pay or Google Pay, and add your eligible debit or credit card. Follow the verification instructions to complete the setup.


### **3. Where is my Wells Fargo virtual card number?**


Once your card is added to a digital wallet, it receives a unique digital card number that replaces your actual card number during supported transactions. You may find its last four digits in your wallet's card details. The complete token number may not be displayed.


### **4. Can I use my Wells Fargo virtual card abroad?**


Yes. Eligible Wells Fargo debit cards can be used internationally through supported digital wallets at participating merchants. However, international usage settings, merchant acceptance and transaction fees may affect your experience. Check your card settings and account terms before travelling.


### **5. Is a Wells Fargo virtual card safe for online payments?**


Yes. Digital wallets replace your actual card number with a unique digital card number, helping prevent merchants from accessing your full card details. Wells Fargo also provides fraud monitoring and Zero Liability protection for qualifying transactions reported promptly, subject to applicable conditions.


**6. What is a good alternative to Wells Fargo virtual cards?**


If you need more flexibility for international payments, Grey is worth considering. Its virtual card supports online spending, while its multicurrency accounts help you hold and manage different currencies. You can also use Grey to send money across borders, including transfers from the US.
